items.name: Propulsion Controller Module
items.description: The Propulsion Controller shall implement a PID control loop with configurable gains (Kp, Ki, Kd). Default tuning: Kp=1.2, Ki=0.05, Kd=0.3.

items.name: Brake Controller Module
items.description: The Brake Controller shall implement ABS logic with 10Hz modulation frequency. Slip threshold: 15%.

items.name: Steering Assist Module
items.description: EPS assist curve: 100% assist at 0-10 km/h, linearly decreasing to 20% at 120 km/h.

items.name: Sensor Hub
items.description: Sensor Hub shall poll all sensors at 100Hz minimum. Data format: 16-bit signed integers, big-endian.

items.name: CAN Interface
items.description: CAN controller: MCP2515 or equivalent. Message IDs: 0x100-0x1FF for VCS, 0x200-0x2FF for diagnostics.

items.name: Fault Manager
items.description: Fault Manager shall maintain fault history (last 100 faults) in EEPROM. DTC format: SAE J2012 compliant.

items.name: Watchdog Configuration
items.description: External watchdog IC: MAX6369. Timeout period: 10ms. Reset pulse width: 100us minimum.
